title: Fix toString error on country selection

requirements.text: Fix the 'Cannot read properties of undefined (reading toString)' error that occurs when a country is selected in the VAT calculator flow

quotes: Once country selected, getting an error- Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'toString'), please fix this

acceptanceCriteria: Country selection completes without throwing toString errors
User can successfully proceed through the calculator flow after selecting a country
All country selection components handle undefined/null values gracefully

requirements.text: Add defensive null/undefined checks in VAT calculation and country selection logic to prevent similar runtime errors
acceptanceCriteria: All country-related data access uses optional chaining or explicit null checks
VAT rate lookups handle missing country data safely
Currency formatting functions validate input before calling toString()

constraints: Preserve existing VAT calculation logic and accuracy
Maintain compatibility with existing URL parameter handling
